title: bma_ui HTTP payloads and hourly rollup records
description: Read-only JSON API of ui/bma_ui.py (GET/HEAD only) and the append-only hourly rollup lines under <data-dir>/reports/ui. Units are in the field names (_s epoch or duration seconds, _db mean-square dB re full scale, _dbfs, _hz, _pct, _deg, _kb, _c). Errors are application/problem+json (the `problem` payload).

code.description: invalid_parameter 422, host_not_allowed 403, method_not_allowed 405, not_found 404, internal_error 500; since 1.4.0 (login enabled): unauthorized 401 (with WWW-Authenticate: Basic) and too_many_attempts 429 (with Retry-After seconds); since 1.5.0: rate_limited 429 (GET /api/spectrum, with Retry-After 1) and spectrum_detail_disabled 403; since 1.7.0: invalid_request 400 (malformed body of a POST), csrf_failed 403 (a POST without the session's CSRF token or from another origin), login_disabled 403 (POST /login on a --require-identity server); a refused passkey is 401 unauthorized; since 1.8.0: not_labelable 422 and labels_unavailable 503 (/api/review/*); since 1.9.0: range_not_satisfiable 416 (GET /api/review/audio, with Content-Range: bytes */size); since 1.13.0 (--ui-next, GET /api/v2/live): origin_not_allowed 403, upgrade_required 426 and too_many_connections 503 (with Retry-After)

human_hidden_24h.description: 1.6.0. Events with a human-voice label (Human vocal, Human non-vocal, Human whistle) that started in the last 24 h and were hidden from every view; a count only, no label, no time. Optional: a server older than 1.6.0 omits it.

spectrum.description: 1.5.0. The spectrum feed at a glance (no rows). Optional: a server older than 1.5.0 omits it.

artifact_gate.description: What the advisory flags run on. enabled false = --no-artifact-gate or the module missing (available false): no artifact_flags anywhere. ambient.records 0 = no temperature feed (every insect reads temp_unknown); transients.in_memory 0 = no dsp transients read (no burst evidence).

artifact.description: Echo of the `artifact` query parameter: any (default) = every event, none = leave out the flagged events (level suspect or likely), only = just the flagged events.
Echo of the `artifact` query parameter: any (default) = every event, none = leave out the flagged events (level suspect or likely), only = just the flagged events.

artifact_events.description: Flagged events among the events counted in `events` (0 for groups the gate does not score, and for the part of a row that comes from rollups).

artifact.description: Echo of the `artifact` query parameter: any (default) = every event, none = leave out the flagged events (level suspect or likely), only = just the flagged events.

artifact_events_total.description: Flagged (suspect or likely) in-memory events matching the other filters, whatever the artifact mode leaves out. Shown next to the toggle so hidden events are always counted.

artifact_unscored_events.description: Insect / mechanical events that come from hourly rollups: they carry no flags, so they are never scored and `artifact=none` cannot leave them out.

spectrum.description: GET /api/spectrum (1.5.0). Magnitude rows only, never samples (specs/spectrum-packet.md). `rows[].bins` is base64 of n_bins uint8 values, dB = v * db_step + db_floor.

spectrum_version.description: spectrum-packet contract version the rows follow

state.description: disabled: no --spectrum-port; no_data: nothing received since start; stale: newest row older than 3 s (rows may still be listed); live; auth_required (1.6.0): the client is not authenticated (an open server, no token file, is not authenticated), no rows and nothing about the feed

edges_hz.description: n_bins + 1 contiguous band edges; empty when disabled

rev.description: revision counter of this tier's ring; +1 whenever rows already served were rewritten (the tag latch)

next_since.description: pass as since= on the next request

rows_missed.description: rows after `since` that already left the ring

t_s.description: end of the row's window, epoch seconds

flags.description: packet flag bits: 1 gated, 2 gap, 4 zero

levels.description: only with compare=true: per beam, the uint8 level of the octave band `band` (power sum of its bins)

healthz.description: GET /healthz (1.10.0), HEAD too: answered without a login on a server with or without one, after the Host check. Liveness only: no version, counter, path or state. `ts` = server epoch seconds.

session.description: GET /api/session (1.7.0), answered only to an authenticated request (401 otherwise; 404 not_found on a server without a login). `csrf` is the token the page sends as X-CSRF-Token (or the form field csrf) on POST /logout and the passkey management POSTs; it is bound to this session and is useless without it. `via`: session (form or passkey login), cookie (the ?token= cookie), basic, tailnet (an allow-listed Tailscale identity from a loopback peer).

user.description: the tailnet login when via is tailnet, else null

item.description: one queue item, null when the queue is empty

artifact_flags.description: absent unless a report of the event carries artifact_flags

clip_png.description: absent when no clip PNG exists

clip_audio.description: since 1.9.0; absent unless the clip's audio file exists (visual-only or expired clip)

clip_span.description: since 1.9.0; present with a clip: the clip and the event span in epoch seconds (the PNG covers clip_start_s..clip_end_s)

recorded.description: false for skip and for an idempotent repeat

queue_depth.description: items the queue serves now (only events with a clip unless --review-allow-no-clip)

no_clip.description: since 1.9.0; candidate events (not skipped, not labelled) without a stored clip PNG or audio

level.description: likely = cold_insect present; suspect = burst_coincident without cold_insect; none otherwise (temp_unknown and mechanical_label alone are none).

artifact_flags.description: Advisory verdict of analysis/artifact_gate.py for one insect or mechanical event (contract artifact-gate 1.0.0, evaluated at the first report of the event). Absent for every other group. Nothing is ever dropped because of it.
